a mischievous little bomber. Headgear: a brown leather aviator cap with round goggles pushed up on the forehead, with long ear flaps. A short blue scarf around its neck. Its small round body is plain dark navy. It carries one prop: a round black bomb held in one stubby arm, with a short fuse that ends in a small bright blue spark. Its face is the simple face of the base body: two small glowing oval eyes and a tiny cheeky mouth. Signature color: bright blue (the fuse spark and the wisps of its ghost tail)

a drowsy little timekeeper. Headgear: a very long droopy dark-violet nightcap that hangs down to one side, with a pale pom-pom at its tip. A small plain dusky-purple shawl. Its small round body is plain dark indigo. It carries two props: a brass hourglass with softly glowing violet sand held in one stubby arm, and a small pocket watch dangling below it on a long thin chain. Its face is the simple face of the base body with half-closed sleepy eyes. Signature color: violet (the glowing sand and the wisps of its ghost tail). Do not use any green or teal anywhere

a stout little knight. Headgear: a dark steel knight helmet with the visor raised and a tall bright orange plume on top. A short tattered dark cape. Its small round body is plain dark slate gray. It carries one prop: a plain steel kite shield held at its side in one stubby arm, with one simple emblem in the center that glows warm orange. Its face is the simple face of the base body: two small glowing oval eyes and a tiny determined mouth. Signature color: warm orange (the shield emblem, the plume and the wisps of its ghost tail)

a broken, falling-apart scarecrow that moves on its own, like a stage prop gone wrong. Head: a tan burlap sack with a crooked stitched smile and two round button eyes, one of them hanging loose by a thread; a faint yellow glow shows through the eye holes. A battered dark-brown wide-brim farmer hat with a torn brim. A ragged patched coat in faded teal and moss green with a rope belt. Straw sticks out of the collar, the cuffs and many rips, and a few bits of straw are falling off. Long thin stick arms held out to the sides, ending in bundles of straw fingers; a broken wooden crossbar is still tied behind its shoulders. Instead of legs it stands on a single wooden pole. Colors: tan burlap, straw yellow, faded teal, brown

an old rusty tin woodman, a big heavy stage automaton. A riveted barrel-shaped tin torso with a large empty heart-shaped hole in the chest: inside the hole there is only darkness and a faint orange ember glow. A small cylindrical head with a hinged jaw, a funnel-shaped tin cap, and two round eye holes that glow dim orange. Thick jointed pipe arms and short heavy legs. Patches of orange-brown rust and dark oil stains dripping from the joints. A faded red rag tied around its neck. It rests a huge long-handled woodcutter axe with a chipped, rust-edged blade on its shoulder. Colors: dull gray-silver tin, orange-brown rust, a little faded red

a winged monkey made of black spirit-smoke. A small monkey whose whole body is one solid inky black-violet silhouette, with soft wisps of dark smoke rising off its edges, two large round glowing violet eyes and a wide mischievous glowing grin. A pair of big tattered feathered wings, dark indigo with violet tips, spread out behind it. A long curling tail that ends in a wisp of smoke. It wears two worn stage-costume pieces: a small red-and-gold pillbox cap with a chin strap, and a short ragged red vest. It hovers in the air, holding a dripping ball of black goo in one raised hand, ready to throw. Colors: inky black-violet, indigo, glowing violet, a little red and gold

a wolf made of black spirit-smoke. A lean wolf on four legs whose whole body is one solid inky black-violet silhouette, with a mane and a tail of flickering violet flame-like smoke, sharp ears, two narrow glowing violet eyes and a jagged glowing mouth full of fangs. Faintly glowing claws. Around its neck hangs a torn length of thick stage rope, like a broken leash, with a small cracked brass tag. It is crouched low, ready to pounce. Colors: inky black-violet, glowing violet, a little rope tan and brass

a spirit hiding inside a big worn-out lion mascot costume from a theater. An oversized round plush lion head with a fluffy orange-brown yarn mane, round ears and a stitched muzzle with a sewn-on fake smile; its wide open mouth is dark inside, and from that darkness two small glowing violet eyes look out. Thin black smoke leaks from the mouth, from the neck seam and from several torn seams. The golden-yellow plush body is patched, with white stuffing coming out of a rip on the belly, floppy paws with felt claws, and a limp tail with a tuft. A faded red ribbon with a tarnished star-shaped medal is pinned on its chest. It slouches forward with its heavy head tilted to one side. Colors: golden-yellow plush, orange-brown mane, black smoke, glowing violet

a tiny dwarf made of black spirit-smoke. A very small stocky figure whose whole body is one solid inky black-violet silhouette with a few wisps of smoke. It wears a tall floppy pointed hat in faded stage-costume blue with a small tarnished bell at the tip; the hat is pulled low, so only two round glowing pink eyes and a zigzag glowing grin show under it. A short ragged cloak and little curled-toe boots. It carries a small hatchet with a black blade in each hand, one of them raised to throw, and leans forward as if scurrying fast. Colors: inky black-violet, faded blue, glowing pink

the boss: a broken, burning witch doll, a life-size ballerina marionette of a witch. A white porcelain doll face with a calm painted smile; one cheek is cracked open and orange fire glows through the cracks; one eye is a glowing orange flame and the other is a painted closed eyelid with long lashes. A tall crooked pointed black witch hat with a wide brim, whose tip burns like a candle wick. Long ash-gray hair in two ragged tails with smoldering ends. A tattered black and deep-purple ballerina dress with a layered tutu, its hem burning away into embers. Ball-jointed doll arms and legs with fine cracks; long black ballet ribbons wrap up her legs to pointe shoes. She balances on the tip of one foot in a graceful ballet pose with the other leg bent and her arms raised. Broken marionette strings trail upward from her wrists, elbows and back, burning at the ends. A ring of small flames floats around her waist. Elegant and eerie, not gory. Colors: porcelain white, black, deep purple, orange fire
